description: Runs all four checks on one address (AI crawler access, structured data, llms.txt, answer readiness) and returns each result plus an overall score: the mean of the crawler, schema and answer-readiness scores. llms.txt is reported but not scored, because the evidence says few systems read it. Free, no key. Docs: https://aeolookup.com/aeo-tools/api/

url.description: The page or site to check, for example https://example.co.uk/ (https:// is added if missing).

name: run_aeo_audit
title: Full AEO audit
